WELCOME TO THE CLUB

Take the scenic route.

Three holes. A cart of your own. No rush.

01 · ExploreUse WASD to walk. Press E near the cart to hop in or out. Follow your ball across the course.

02 · Set upWalk within 8 yards of the ball. Choose a club, then aim with the arrow keys or “Aim at pin”. The dotted line shows your shot.

03 · SwingHold Space or the swing button to build power; release to hit. Watch the ball fly, then drive to your next shot. Use a putter on the green.
